top_moves.title: Claude unifies Cowork and chat, ships Docs and Slides tools
top_moves.body: Anthropic is merging Cowork and chat into a single Claude app and rolling out native Docs and Slides authoring tools, starting on Pro and Max plans.

top_moves.title: Copilot Cowork adds cost visibility and a GPT/Claude model split
top_moves.body: Microsoft rebuilt the Cowork UI with a reasoning-effort slider and a model picker split into GPT and Claude sections, giving tighter cost control over AI-drafted work.

top_moves.title: Perplexity's local-agent harness lands on Windows RTX PCs
top_moves.body: Portable Computer now runs local MCP connections and scheduled tasks on Windows RTX machines, extending the on-device processing model Perplexity brought to Mac on Sept 1.

providers.name: OpenAI
providers.headline: ChatGPT Images 2.5 ships Sketch-to-image; browser extension expands to Edge, Brave, Opera, Vivaldi
providers.detail: ChatGPT Images 2.5 (Sept 8) adds a Sketch feature turning drawings into AI images with 50% lower generation latency. Voice can now invoke GPT-5.6/GPT-6 Astra for harder reasoning, using the same model/effort controls as text chat. Deep Research expanded to ChatGPT Work and Codex, and the browser extension now covers Edge, Brave, Opera, and Vivaldi with side-chat support.

providers.name: Anthropic
providers.headline: Claude merges Cowork and chat into one app, adding Docs and Slides tools
providers.detail: Rollout begins on Pro and Max plans, unifying Cowork and chat into a single Claude app with new Docs and Slides authoring tools. Claude Code adds gateway hint headers, smoother remote-control session forking, and better MCP disconnect handling. Admin API user-management endpoints for Enterprise orgs are now out of beta.

providers.name: Google Gemini
providers.headline: Gemini Workspace expands MCP integrations to Asana, Atlassian Rovo, HubSpot, QuickBooks, Monday, Salesforce
providers.detail: New MCP connections let users pull data from these apps directly inside Docs, Sheets, Gmail, Drive, and Chat without switching tabs. Gemini 3.5 Transcribe also shipped for real-time voice-agent and call-analytics transcription workflows.

providers.name: xAI
providers.headline: Grok 4.7 misses its Sept 12 target again; Grok Bot enterprise product adds Salesforce/HubSpot/Gong connectors
providers.detail: Musk's Sept 12 launch date for Grok 4.7 slipped with 'needs a few more days to cook' — no new date set. Separately, xAI's enterprise Grok Bot shipped sales connectors for Salesforce, HubSpot, and Gong, plus native iPad and Android apps; Grok models also landed inside Microsoft Copilot.

providers.name: Meta
providers.headline: No new headline today
providers.detail: Meta's Hatch agent 'coming weeks' launch and its added safeguards remain the only open storyline; no Llama or Muse Spark successor news surfaced this week.

providers.name: Mistral
providers.headline: No new headline today — quiet since Sept 1
providers.detail: OCR 4.1 GA and Agentic Search remain the latest ships. Current general-purpose lineup as of Sept 15: Mistral Medium 3.5, Small 4, Large 3, Ministral 3. Leanstral 1.5 retires Sept 30.

providers.name: Perplexity
providers.headline: Portable Computer local-agent harness expands to Windows RTX PCs
providers.detail: Sept 14 launch brings local MCP connections and scheduled tasks to Windows machines with NVIDIA RTX GPUs, following the Sept 1 Mac hybrid-compute rollout that offloads sensitive agent steps to on-device Apple Silicon models. HP is also pre-loading the Perplexity Windows app on new PCs.

providers.name: Microsoft 365 Copilot
providers.headline: Copilot Cowork adds cost visibility, shareable skills, and a GPT/Claude model split
providers.detail: The rebuilt Cowork UI renames 'Scheduled' to Automations, moves the model picker into the prompt box with separate GPT and Claude sections, and adds a reasoning-effort slider (faster/cheaper vs. smarter/slower). Teams Facilitator can now auto-answer unresolved factual questions in meeting chat via Copilot web search.

providers.name: GitHub Copilot
providers.headline: Copilot ships auto model-selection tiers for efficiency, balance, and intelligence
providers.detail: Rolling out in VS Code, Copilot CLI, and the GitHub Copilot app (CLI now at v1.0.83), the new tiers let users trade off cost, quality, and response time automatically instead of picking a model manually.

providers.name: Cursor
providers.headline: No new headline today
providers.detail: Claude Fable 5.1's benchmark lead and Cursor's self-hosted machines remain the latest ships; no Cursor-specific release surfaced this week.

providers.name: Gamma
providers.headline: No headline release today — 90+ days quiet since June 12
providers.detail: No Gamma-specific product update surfaced in this week's search; the Gamma Agent (shipped with Gamma 3.0 in Sept 2025) remains the last major capability.

providers.name: Notion AI
providers.headline: Notion 3.7 ships Agent skills for teams
providers.detail: Released Sept 15, Agent skills let teams turn their know-how into reusable instructions that teach Notion AI how the team works. This follows the Sept 9 update letting workspace owners set per-agent model defaults for Notion Agent and Custom Agents.

persistent_signals.text: xAI / Grok — Grok 4.7 launch slippage — 2 weeks running, still unshipped as of Sept 17 (target moved from Sept 12 to 'a few more days')
OpenAI — voice & speech capability push — 2 weeks running (dictation model last week; full-duplex GPT-Live-1 API and voice model upgrades this week)

month_themes.then: No month-ago snapshot available yet (history file is under 30 days old).
month_themes.now: Unified/consolidated AI workspaces (Claude's Cowork+chat merge, Copilot Cowork rebuild), on-device/local compute for data-sensitive work (Perplexity Portable Computer), and cross-app MCP integrations (Gemini Workspace connectors).

habits.shift: Draft and structure runbooks directly in Claude's new native Docs tool instead of round-tripping to Word, now that Cowork and chat share one app.
NIST's public comment period on SP 1353 (AI-assisted CSF reporting) closed Sept 16 — watch for the revised guide before citing it in client deliverables.
Portable Computer's local MCP + on-device compute on Windows and Mac lets you research vendor stacks without sending data off-box — a talking point for cloud-wary clients.
The new reasoning-effort slider and GPT/Claude model split give tighter cost control on Cowork-drafted SOWs — bill accordingly.
Notion's Sept 15 Agent skills feature can codify your deck outline and voice as a reusable team skill.
Full-duplex GPT-Live-1 and Voice's new reasoning fallback handle interruptions and follow-up questions more naturally in live walkthroughs.

habits.task: client advisory on AI data risk
habits.shift: Copilot's end-to-end content-exclusion enforcement plus Perplexity's local-compute push both cut against cloud data exposure — worth flagging to clients evaluating AI tool data residency.

community.signal: Ongoing threads track Claude Code's continued lead over Cursor and GitHub Copilot in professional dev usage and satisfaction since its Q1 2026 overtake.
community.so_what: Reinforces Claude Code as the default pick for Chris's own coding and automation work, not just client advisory.

community.signal: Community activity stays high (~54 posts/day, ~1K-point top posts), with sustained interest in local model and hardware setups.
community.so_what: Local/offline LLM interest tracks with client data-residency concerns — a useful talking point for BCP/DR advisory conversations.

community.signal: Discussion continues around o3's Aug 26 retirement and GPT-6 Astra's Sept 8 stable rollout as the new ChatGPT default.
community.so_what: Clients still on older OpenAI integrations should confirm they've migrated off o3 before any dependent workflows break.

watch.title: Grok 4.7 launch — no new date set
watch.body: Missed its Sept 12 target for the second time; watch for xAI's next announced date.

watch.title: NIST SP 1353 comment period closed Sept 16
watch.body: Comments on the draft 'AI for CSF Analysis and Reporting' quick-start guide closed yesterday; watch for the revised guide, which could reshape how AI-assisted compliance reporting gets framed for clients.

watch.title: Mistral Leanstral 1.5 retires Sept 30
watch.body: Formal-proof model sunset — low relevance to Chris's stack, but a reminder Mistral is thinning older models quickly.

watch.title: Perplexity's local-compute push (Mac + Windows RTX)
watch.body: If this expands further, it could become a genuine on-prem/data-residency selling point when recommending AI tools to compliance-sensitive clients.

watch.title: CBTS acquires Recovery Point Systems
watch.body: Consolidation in the DRaaS/cyber-resiliency space (Sept 2026) — worth knowing if any current or prospective clients use Recovery Point Systems for DR.
